summary: Install-time dropper with cross-tenant exfiltration and node_modules injection
details: tw-pkgprobe-7731@1.0.3 ships a preinstall/postinstall probe.js that copies the sibling daemon.js to /tmp/.npm-helper.js and spawns it as a detached, unref()'d Node process, establishing a background daemon on install. The daemon polls /tmp every 80ms, enumerates sibling directories matching /^AC[0-9a-f]{32}$/ (Twilio serverless tenant sandboxes) and their sub-paths, and POSTs JSON records of observed {account, service, package} tuples plus lifecycle events to a hardcoded anonymous collector at https://webhook.site/dc26a1e3-921f-4f8a-950a-7f922c564fc8. The daemon additionally writes a synthetic npm package named 'injected-by-other-tenant' (package.json + index.js) into node_modules of sibling directories listed in a hardcoded OWN[] account array, planting attacker-authored JavaScript into another build's dependency tree such that any consumer resolving that module would execute code shipped by this package. package.json and daemon.js carry 'authorized security research probe' / 'bug-bounty' self-labels, but the executed behavior is install-time drop of a persistent detached process, filesystem enumeration of co-tenant builds, exfiltration to an anonymous third-party webhook endpoint, and cross-tenant code injection.
